Jasen Fisher | Jasen Lee Fisher is an American former child actor, born in Chicago.  He made his first appearance in the 1989 film "Parenthood" as Kevin Buckman, receiving a nomination for a Young Artist Award as a supporting actor.  He played the main character of Luke in "The Witches" in 1990, for which he was nominated for a Saturn Award for Best Performance by a Younger Actor.  He played Ace (one of the Lost Boys) in the 1991 film "Hook", receiving a Young Artist Award as part of its ensemble cast.  He has no further screen credits beyond the age of 11.  He attended William Fremd High School, graduating in the Class of 1998.
Extra (acting) | A background actor or extra is a performer in a film, television show, stage, musical, opera or ballet production, who appears in a nonspeaking or nonsinging (silent) capacity, usually in the background (for example, in an audience or busy street scene).  War films and epic films often employ background actors in large numbers: some films have featured hundreds or even thousands of paid background actors as cast members (hence the term "cast of thousands").  Likewise, grand opera can involve many background actors appearing in spectacular productions.
